meta: AI will soon have read all the text on the internet, so where will it get more data? Bit explains: synthetic data is data made by AI itself, like millions of math problems with solutions, filtered carefully.
thu: Ask AI to write 5 math problems with solutions, then work each one out yourself. You'll see why the filtering step matters.

muc.title: Running out of data?
muc.text: Mark hears that AI will soon have read all the text on the internet, and wants to know where it will get more data to learn from.

muc.title: Data made by AI
muc.text: Bit explains: one way is synthetic data, data made by AI itself. For example, AI writes millions of math problems with solutions.

muc.title: Check before using
muc.text: The key step is careful filtering: recheck the math, run the code, and only keep what's correct.

muc.title: Filling gaps where data is rare
muc.text: It's useful where real data is rare or sensitive: unusual situations, or made-up records so real people's information isn't exposed.

muc.title: A photocopy of a photocopy
muc.text: The risk: if AI only learns from AI, over time it's like a photocopy of a photocopy, getting blurrier. This is called model collapse, so real data always has to be mixed in.

muc.title: When you see this word
muc.text: When you see this word, think: data AI makes to teach AI, useful when it's filtered carefully.
